[[Shooshadoo]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] [[shield]] crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]], connected to the [[Heart of Thorns]] expansion through the required tasks and materials. Shooshadoo was first teased on November 15th, 2016 and introduced in the game on [[Game updates/2016-11-21|November 21st, 2016]] alongside the [[Living World Season 3]] episode [[A Crack in the Ice]].

== Lore ==
{{Legendary unlock text|The tiny [[quaggan]] Shooshadoo has made up their mind to follow in your footsteps as a champion of [[Tyria]]. You'll need to carry them until their stride is a bit longer.}}

== Graphics ==
;Aura
* The arm wielding Shooshadoo turns white and gets covered with frost.

;Draw/Stow Animation
* Upon drawing the weapon, it creates an explosion of snow and ice shards.

;Footfalls
* While wielding Shooshadoo with no other legendary weapon in the main hand, the user leaves behind white, snowy footsteps that subtly explode with frost.

;Skill effects
* {{chronomancer}} [[Chronomancer]]: [[Tides of Time]] has a copy of [[Shooshadoo]] spinning in the center.
* {{engineer}} [[Engineer]]: [[Throw Shield]] throws Shooshadoo instead.
* {{herald}} [[Herald]]: [[Envoy of Exuberance]] throws Shooshadoo instead.

;Sound effects
All of the sound effects are tied to the "effects" volume slide.
* When drawing the weapon, a very faint wrestling ring bell sound plays, together with an icy whirlwind sound.
* When the weapon is stowed, a sound of water splashing may play.
* The quaggan will sometimes coo when stowing the weapon.
* The quaggan will rarely coo while the player is idle, possibly sleeping.
* The quaggan always coos when mounting or dismounting from any mount.
